observations.description: Upper-right interaction near (539,306) is a solid filled ink point. Italic A lies just right and slightly below. The incoming dashed arrow joins from above-right; a solid leftward arrow joins B; the wandering dashed track leaves down-right.

Near (447,319), B is a ring with distinct dark central ink. Italic B is left-below the ring. The solid A-to-B positron arrow points left into B. Two solid oscillating gamma tracks leave B upward and downward, each with an outward terminal arrowhead.

Near (135,413), C is an open outlined loop with light interior, not an independently resolved filled center. Italic C is to its right. The dashed wandering path ends in this neighborhood and three solid gamma tracks leave upward, down-left and down-right. Tiny local joins are uncertain; they do not justify adding a distinct filled nucleus.
